capabilities: Create and edit interactive 5e character sheets embedded as code blocks in notes
Compute rules-derived values such as AC, HP, saves, skills, spell slots and spell DC
Roll dice from the sheet with advantage and disadvantage modifiers
Import rules data from 5etools JSON folders and 5etools-format homebrew files
Link races, classes, spells and items to compendium notes with hover previews
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been reviewed by Obsidian staff. It ships only SRD 5.1 and SRD 5.2.1 content; book content must be imported by users from data they own. Mobile support works but is less tested, and it requires Obsidian 1.4+.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to create, maintain, and roll from D&D 5e character sheets inside a player's vault of campaign notes.

relations.evidence: Uses the Dice Roller plugin when it is installed, a built-in roller otherwise.
name, level, hp, ac and modifier in the note's properties, which Initiative Tracker reads
or import the books you own and 5etools homebrew.
ttrpg-convert-cli turns the same 5etools data into notes for your vault

summary: Interactive D&D 5e character sheets that live in notes, with automatic rules, built-in SRD data, optional 5etools import, and in-sheet dice rolls.
